decision: Use canonical host-payload identity as the occupancy actor and require exact host, lease, and verified ritual alignment

governingRule.description: Issue #3611's approved cooperative host-session routing contract is authoritative and must not be represented as same-user authentication

alternativesConsidered.option: Use ritual state as the ordinary caller identity

whyWinner: Host payload IDs survive fresh hook processes without adding replayable project state; exact lifecycle rewriting bridges claim time, while lease and exact verified ritual equality fail closed under the existing cooperative file model
revisitTrigger: Revisit if a supported host lacks a stable payload ID, Cursor family semantics change, or Directive adopts an OS-authenticated broker
